title: Auto Farm Auto Plant Auto Harvest Auto Fuel Mine Auto Collec
features:
**Farm Tab:**
+ Auto Farm Resources (with multi-select resource dropdown)
+ Auto Plant (plants seeds on random garden bed positions)
+ Auto Harvest (checks Grown and OutputVisible attributes)
+ Auto Sell (sells all backpack items with Hash attribute)
+ Sell Delay Slider (0.1 to 1 second)
+ Auto Fuel Mine (only when Coal Crate is in backpack)
+  Auto Collect Gold Mine
+ Auto Craft (multi-select crafters with delay between each craft)
+ Craft Delay Slider (0.1 to 1 second)

**Shop Tab:**
+ Auto Buy Seeds (with sold-out check and multi-select dropdown)
+ Auto Buy Bees (with sold-out check and multi-select dropdown)
+ Auto Buy Potions (with sold-out check and multi-select dropdown)

**Additional Features:**
+ Dynamic resource loading from ReplicatedStorage
+ Dynamic seed/bee/potion loading with string filtering
+ Dynamic crafter loading with Display attribute names
+ Multi-select dropdowns for most features
+ Sold-out checking for shop purchases
+ HP attribute checking for resource farming
+ Coal Crate requirement checking for mine fueling
+ Config tab with save/load functionality
